Biden administration discusses cryptocurrency guardrails that still allow investors to ‘dogecoin to their heart’s content’

Robinhood revenue rose 309% in Q1 to $522MM.  Of that, $420MM (~80%) came from payment-for-order flow, up 340% Y/Y.  Of that, $87MM (~21%) was from crypto payment-for-order flow, up 1,967% Y/Y.  Of that, ~34% was from Dogecoin. #Robinhood
ROBINHOOD SAYS DOGECOIN MADE UP 40% OF CRYPTO REVENUE IN Q3
